coy.definition:
s. affectedly modest or shy especially in a playful or provocative way
s. showing marked and often playful or irritating evasiveness or reluctance to make a definite or committing statement
s. modestly or warily rejecting approaches or overtures
coy.translation: a. 腼腆的, 怕羞的, 羞怯的

coydog.definition: n offspring of a coyote and a dog
coydog.translation: n. [动]科伊狗(丛林狼和野狗的杂交后代)

coyed.translation:
n. 假装害羞的( coy的名词复数 ); 忸怩作态的; 故作谦虚的; 不肯明说的
v. 假装害羞的( coy的过去式 ); 忸怩作态的; 故作谦虚的; 不肯明说的

coying.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Coy
coying.translation: v. 假装害羞的( coy的过去分词 ); 忸怩作态的; 故作谦虚的; 不肯明说的

coyish.translation: a. 腼腆的；忸怩作态的；怕羞的 (coy的变形)

coyly.translation: adv. 害羞地, 羞怯地

coyness.definition: n. the affectation of being demure in a provocative way

coyolymerization.translation: [医] 异分子聚合, 共聚(作用)

coyote.definition:
n. small wolf native to western North America
n. someone who smuggles illegal immigrants into the United States (usually across the Mexican border)
n. a forest fire fighter who is sent to battle remote and severe forest fires (often for days at a time)
coyote.translation: n. 丛林狼, 讨厌的家伙

coyote state.translation: 土狼州（美国南达科塔州别名，因该州多丛林狼而得名）

coyotes.definition:
n. small wolf native to western North America
n. someone who smuggles illegal immigrants into the United States (usually across the Mexican border)
n. a forest fire fighter who is sent to battle remote and severe forest fires (often for days at a time)
coyotes.translation: n. 郊狼（北美洲西部原野上的小狼）( coyote的复数形式 ); 丛林狼, 草原狼

coyotillo.translation: n. [植]鼠李科之有毒灌木(产于美西南及墨西哥)

coyoting.translation: 不规则的小窑开采, 滥采

coypu.definition: n. aquatic South American rodent resembling a small beaver; bred for its fur
